gravityAnalyticsSdk.finding: analytics SDK only; it is not the battle movement or path solver

randomness.shopRule: normal shop calls BattleScene.rand without randMark and therefore uses Math.random

implementation.normalEntry: shop, route jitter and probabilistic outcomes use Math.random like the original
implementation.captureAndSmoke: labeled independent deterministic LCG streams, including a dedicated route stream, preserve reproducible golden evidence without perturbing combat rolls

randomness.remainingBoundary: the original process-wide Math.random internal state at the supplied recording time is not present in the package

unitRoute.targetSelection: select the nearest live opposing unit or building only when no valid cached target exists; cacheTarget defaults true, so a live target remains locked while its point follows movement; death or destruction invalidates it and triggers reselection; BaseBuild uses its top-center battle proxy anchor and clamps steering x to the nearest horizontal edge; castle remains the fallback target
unitRoute.targetDistanceAttenuation: max(0, 1 - fireRange*2/distance); random heading becomes zero at or inside twice the attack range
unitRoute.sameTeamCollision: fixed radius 50 scaled by actor scaleX; physical contact persists until summed radii separate, force uses 1-distance/averageRadius, stores the maximum weight per contact, and applies insertion-order multipliers 1.1
unitRoute.bossRule: a boss does not collect stayEqualCollider contacts; ordinary units can still repel from a boss present in their own contact set
unitRoute.playerUnitRule: PlayerUnit overrides order=-1 and searchRange=-1, uses the same cached-target, random-heading, map-bound and same-team collider solver as EnemyUnit, applies the mirrored y>0.5 backward correction, and falls back upward when no enemy exists
unitRoute.enemySearchRangeRule: BaseUnit defaults routeSerchRange to 600 pixels and EnemyUnit keeps it; first acquisition filters by Euclidean distance with an inclusive <=600 boundary, while an already cached live target remains valid after moving beyond the range; with no target the enemy falls back downward
unitRoute.backwardCorrection: enemy forward vectors below y=-0.5 receive +0.5 y before renormalization
unitRoute.implementationClaim: recovered shared PlayerUnit/EnemyUnit UnitRoute with order-specific fallback and backward correction, cacheTarget lifetime/invalidation, target geometry, distance-attenuated heading, draw order and exact unit_collider force geometry with a deterministic local contact-set adapter; not A* and not the Gravity analytics SDK
